{{Top}}
'''Pulsar skates''' were deep-sea creatures that were native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

[[Booster Terrik]] named [[Pulsar Skate|one of his ships]] after the creatures.
